$Comment: A daily contract on the Nightmare preset: win one Kweebec Nightmare round, collect on the spot.
Repeat.Reset is a calendar allowance rather than a rolling wait: the window rolls over at the
server day boundary, so all three dailies come back together and a player who finishes late in
the evening is not paid back at the same hour tomorrow. Author Times inside Reset to allow more
than one finish per window, or swap Reset for Cooldown to make it a rolling timer instead.
The reward rides the Auto bucket, paying out the moment the round is won, so nobody has to trek back to
the Wilds between runs. It is the one difference from the story beats above, which are collected
The lootable reward rolls this pack's own dedicated daily table (Mmo_Kweebec_Daily_Nightmare), so
retuning that table retunes this payout without touching the minigame's own chase rewards; the
flat Defense experience beside it is authored here.
